sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: A color typed (six or three hex digits after #, or rgb(r, g, b)) or picked, kept as #rrggbb: a field with a swatch of the color at its end that opens a picker of saturation and brightness, hue and swatches.

anatomy.container: A field as the other typed fields draw it (parts/text-field's frame, label, help and issues), its placeholder #rrggbb.
anatomy.swatch: At the frame's end, the picker's button: a square 16 across in the color, rounded by radius-mini, ringed 1 inside in foreground at 20 percent; empty, the ring alone.
anatomy.picker: Under the frame in a popover padded 12: a column 224 wide, 12 apart, of the area, the hue strip and the swatches.
anatomy.area: 144 tall, rounded by radius-control: the hue at full saturation under a fade to black upward from the foot and a fade from white at the start, so across is saturation and up is brightness; its mark a dot 14 across in the color, edged 2 in background, ringed 1 in foreground at 40 percent.
anatomy.hue: A strip 12 tall, rounded full, through the hues around the circle; its thumb a dot 16 across in the hue at full saturation, edged as the area's mark.
anatomy.swatches: With swatches: a grid of eight columns 6 apart of squares in each swatch's color, rounded by radius-control, ringed 1 inside in foreground at 15 percent; the one that is the value ringed 2 in foreground, offset 2 in popover.

onValueChange.does: Called with each color typed that reads or picked, and none when emptied.

swatches.does: Colors to pick with one press, each with its name.

required.does: A required field has no clear button.

rest.means: The color written and shown in its swatch.

open.means: The picker open under the frame.
open.reached: the swatch pressed, or Alt and the down arrow in the input

unreadable.means: Text that is not a color: the value kept as it was, the issue said once the field is left.
unreadable.reached: typing text that does not read

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the area, the hue thumb or a swatch: the focus ring.

keyboard.does: Less or more saturation, a hundredth; with Shift, a tenth.
More or less brightness, a hundredth; with Shift, a tenth.

words.example: Write six hex digits after #, or rgb(r, g, b).

example.en: Write six hex digits after #, or rgb(r, g, b).
